note: A probability that a large move is coming, not a direction and not a prediction. Even in the top 5% of scores, most days are not big days.

cautions.direction: The score says a big move is likelier. It says nothing about which way.
cautions.base_rate: A 3.9x lift on a 9.4% base rate is a real edge and still wrong most of the time.
cautions.clustering: The signal is mostly volatility clustering: big days follow big days. That is a description of the past, and it can fail exactly when a quiet market breaks without warning.
cautions.compression: Volatility compression - the textbook setup - did NOT precede big days here. The data shows the opposite: already-elevated volatility did.
cautions.hindsight: Absolute extension was chosen because a big move can come from either side of the mean. I noticed it on the morning of a big move, so treat the choice with suspicion - the top-20% lift is lower than the signed version's, not higher.
